stories.title: Gillman sets records as Griz roll past Bulldogs, 45-10
stories.description: Eli Gillman set a Montana record for career rushing touchdowns as the Griz rolled past Drake 45-10 and improved to 2-0.

stories.title: Griz look to build momentum against Drake
stories.description: Montana entered Drake week 1-0, looking to build momentum before a challenging late-September road swing.

stories.title: Mason named Big Sky Special Teams Player of the Week
stories.description: Jake Mason was named co-Special Teams Player of the Week after a standout performance against Southern Utah.

stories.title: Griz outlast T-Birds in Kennedy’s debut
stories.description: Bobby Kennedy won his Montana debut as the Griz held off Southern Utah 28-21 in the 2026 opener.
